question_it_answers: which complete configuration entered forward mode
base_chain_scope: the eight scientific artifacts ONLY. It was computed before the coverage-gap note existed and is left unchanged on purpose: base identity is fixed, activation identity is what this file adds.
runtime_identity: the commit SHA, never a branch name — `main` moves, a SHA does not

superseded.reason: the legacy seal() overwrote a fixed path; the predecessor's bytes are unrecoverable and are NOT reconstructed, because rebuilding an artifact after the fact is fabrication rather than preservation
superseded.fixed_by: seal() now refuses to overwrite differing content unless supersede=True, which archives the predecessor first

floors_naming.why: the frozen historical table applied no floor at all; the forward rule does, so forward is strictly narrower and must not be described as reproducing historical semantics

coverage.neither: not used in discovery, not admitted to forward accrual
coverage.denominator_note: 448 is 2.24% OF THE 20,000 LOCK TARGET. It is not '2.24% of historical data lost' — those are different denominators and must not be conflated.
coverage.say_this_not_that: report 'nominal cutoff 2026-08-20, effective T5 evidence through 2026-08-17' rather than 'historical data through 2026-08-20', which is true of the 1D bar store and no longer true of T5
